lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) data on a monthly schedule throughout 2017. The spatial classifications were aggregated into geographic datasets representing medium-term food insecurity projections for February, June, and October 2017, capturing the severity and extent of acute food insecurity across Burkina Faso administrative areas.
